decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from BurntSushi/jiff PR #606 (fixes issue #585), merged 2026-07-19T10:19:29Z. Labeled decontaminated: true because the fix post-dates the May 2026 training cutoff of the models this suite targets (Claude Opus 5); re-check `upstream_merged` against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Every `<type>::strftime` method returns a `Display` impl, and `Display` cannot surface errors, so any formatting failure panicked on conversion to String. The fix switches those `Display` impls to lenient mode (src/fmt/strtime/mod.rs plus the five call sites in src/civil/{date,datetime,time}.rs, src/timestamp.rs and src/zoned.rs), emitting unrenderable directives verbatim instead of failing. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (ddd26a89). NOTE: this base is 9 hours after jiff PR #604 introduced the `jiff-core` crate, so unlike the v3 jiff tasks the slice is a two-crate workspace (root `jiff` + `crates/jiff-core` as a path dependency `jcore`). It still builds fully offline with zero external crates because jiff-core's only dependencies (defmt, log) are optional and its quickcheck dev-dependency is trimmed; verified with `docker run --network none ... cargo build --offline`. Unlicense/MIT licenses and the four include_str!'d docs (CHANGELOG/COMPARE/DESIGN/PLATFORM.md) preserved. Coverage: 5 fail_to_pass tests, each verified to panic at the base commit and pass after the gold patch, spanning trailing `%`, unrecognised directive, lone `%`, a directive needing an absent field, and a non-Zoned (civil Date) receiver. The 3 pass_to_pass regression guards assert only well-formed directives, never mentioning lenient behaviour, so they compile and pass at the base commit. All expected constants are generated from the gold patch; `"1970 %"` matches the doc example added by the upstream PR itself.
